name: Band Terminal Knee Extension
steps: Anchor a resistance band at knee height, step one leg through the loop behind your knee, and step back to build tension.
Stand tall facing the anchor with your opposite foot planted firmly and your working knee slightly bent with heel lifted.
Press your working heel down and straighten your knee smoothly against the band until your quadriceps lock out firmly.
Pause briefly to squeeze your quad, bend your knee slowly back into the band, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning backward to pull the band straight.
Focus on a crisp, controlled final lockout of the knee without snapping the joint aggressively.
